parameters.content:
## 1. RECEIVE IMAGE
The camera POSTs a photo (multipart field image, or JSON image_url / image_base64) plus place or lat+lng. Old JSON-only payloads still work.

## 2. SEE + JUDGE
Vision API describes what is happening. Jev API picks the violation type and severity from that description. Unsure or unknown cases go to AI triage (3a).

## 3. RE-JUDGE
Bumps severity for repeat offenders, school/hospital zones, night-time danger. Drops it for low confidence. Accidents are always CRITICAL.

## 4. ROUTING TABLE
The ONLY place to edit: zones, stations, who is emailed per severity, response times.

## 5. WHO + WHERE
GPS to nearest zone, picks recipients, writes the email including WHY it was routed.

## 6. ACT
CRITICAL: inspector + SHO + DCP + control room (+108 if injury)
HIGH: inspector + SHO
MEDIUM: inspector
LOW: logged only
